notes: Exercise library expanded from 43 to 198 available exercises, with aliases and equipment filters.

Custom exercises retain their identities, equipment labels and load conventions, and are clearly marked in the library.

Chart, Focus Mode and plan-creator concepts remain available in the separate design review.
